description:
DeriveCallGraphComponent(f) re-walks f's whole reachable cone on every wake (collect_static_graph), discovering it one blocked evaluation per layer, then runs a private SCC (strong_component). transport.rs statically_reaches is a second private walker over the same edges. The design tried here: replace both with one cumulative fact Reaches(f) = edges(f) joined with Reaches(g) for each direct callee g (absent reads as empty with a subscription), Recursive(f) = f in Reaches(f), CallGraphComponent(f) = min over m in {f} plus Reaches(f) with f in Reaches(m), transport's question = owner in Reaches(from); delete collect_static_graph, strong_component, statically_reaches.

BUILT AND MEASURED 2026-09-16 (patch kept in the session scratchpad as kdt98-2-reaches.patch; not committed). Answers exactly right: corpus canon 548/548 byte-identical, the 00181 component/recursion map identical. Cost goes UP, not down: 00181 job starts 443 -> 532 (DeriveReaches +61 of which 31 blocked, DeriveCallGraphComponent 31 -> 55); json_roundtrip 4527 -> 5705 (+26%; DeriveReaches 668, DeriveCallGraphComponent 139 -> 646, of which only 157 evaluations moved content; worst function 12 -> 110 evaluations). Mechanism, probed: the scheduler wakes by fact rank then FunctionId, not reverse-topologically, so a per-node transitive-closure formula re-derives once per layer of ascent that arrives after it, and the component job subscribes to the whole cone's Reaches facts, which keep moving through the entire ascent, where the walk subscribed to StaticCallees, which stop moving early. The walk is cheap in evaluations and expensive per evaluation; the local join is the reverse; the census counts evaluations. Variants measured: Current reads of Reaches for Recursive/Component 538 (worse than the settled read's 532); all three facts in one job 494 and deadlocks on 00181 (a job waits on a peer's copy of the fact it publishes itself). Nine census pins would rise (transport_contract_test 443 -> 532, public_trace_test DeriveCallGraphComponent (67,25) -> (152,97), semantic formula work 1156 -> 1468, work_start_reason 4197 -> 4804, blocked_waiter_expansion 24 -> 26, drive_test one-walk 1 -> 21, three shape pins). Not authorized to raise; stopped.

Defect surfaced on the way, worth keeping in any shape: statically_reaches is reflexive by construction (it tests function == owner before consuming an edge), and the transport cut of 00346_self_apply_tail_call depends on that: a self-applying body whose only recursion runs through a closure value has f not in Reaches(f), and without the explicit from == owner case the TransportShape(ExecutableReturn) cycle goes uncut and fz2 run fails. The reflexivity is undocumented today.

Status: the user decides among (A) accept the raise, (B) keep one cone walk per function and publish its result as Reaches so strong_component and the transport walk go away with the ladder kept, (C) drop this ticket and decide fz-kdt.98.1's own raise (443 -> 454) on its merits.
title: Reachability is one monotone formula per function; the component cone walk and the transport reachability walk go away
